# Pawsley Chews (Dog Supplement): Instructions

Note: this document is a sample for testing. Pawsley Chews is a fictional product, and nothing here is feeding advice for any real product.

## 1 About the product

Pawsley Chews is a nutritional supplement that supports joint health in adult dogs.

- Contents: 60 chews
- Weight of one chew: 500 mg

The weight of one chew is 0.5 g.

## 2 How to give

Mix the amount in the table below into your dog's usual food.

| Age | Amount | Times a day |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 to 6 years | 1 chew | 2 |
| 7 years and over | 2 chews | 2 |

Do not give to puppies under 1 year old.

Dogs aged 7 and over can have 2 chews at a time, up to 2 times a day. The maximum daily amount is 4 chews.

Leave at least 8 hours between feedings, and do not give more than 2 feedings a day.

## 3 Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount in one chew |
| --- | --- |
| Glucosamine-like blend (fictional) | 200 mg |
| Cartilage-like blend (fictional) | 100 mg |
| Mussel-like blend (fictional) | 50 mg |
| Total | 350 mg |

## 4 Storage

Keep Pawsley Chews out of direct sunlight, in a cool place.
